label: Lab module
lead: Lab errors are usually process errors, not technique errors. The sample got mislabelled. The doctor wasn’t notified. The report didn’t reach the patient. Lucoze’s lab module fixes the process — with barcodes, role-based hand-offs, and a status feed everyone sees.

stats.label: Barcoded chain of custody, sample to report

rows.title: Barcode at collection. Visible at every station.
rows.lead: Collection → receiving → processing → verification → report. Each station scans, updates, hands off. The doctor knows where the sample is without a phone call. The patient gets the WhatsApp update when it’s actually ready.
bullets: Pre-printed barcodes or print-on-demand at collection.
Sample rejection workflow with reason codes — quality trends are visible.
Outsourced tests tracked alongside in-house — one report, one TAT.

rows.title: Reports the patient actually understands.
rows.lead: Doctor-friendly format on one side, patient-friendly format on the other. Critical values flag automatically. The signing pathologist’s details are NABL-compliant. Patient can download the PDF without calling the lab.
bullets: Reference-range flagging by sex / age — H, L, panic-high in colour.
NABL audit trail — who signed, when, on which method.
Patient downloads via WhatsApp or the patient app — no portal login.

faqs.q: NABL audit trail — is the format ready for inspection?
faqs.a: Yes. We worked with three NABL-accredited labs in Bhubaneswar and Lucknow to verify the audit log format. Lab plans include the inspection-ready report bundle on request.

faqs.q: Can we use it without a pathologist on site?
faqs.a: Yes — outsource module routes samples to a contracted lab and re-imports the report under your branding. The patient sees one report; the regulator sees the audit chain.
